resolution.note: ledger --unused and adopt --prune-unused proven on plain transcript captures: unused server and skill listed with token weight, disable entries written, rerun changes nothing

title: Unused MCP servers and skills are pruned per adopted project from measured use
body:
Why: operator-shared AI LABS video 1kQ_1_QL5Es (TokenEconomizer, description only; claim of 24-31% cost cut unverified): KRN measures skill and MCP token weight but never learns from use which ones a project never calls.
Outcome: krn ledger reports per project the MCP servers and skills with 0 calls across the last 2 or more sessions; krn adopt offers to disable them in the project settings with the token saving named.
Files: src/outcome/ledger.ts, src/adopt/first-turn.ts, tests.
Proof: a ledger test on verbatim transcript captures lists an unused server and its token weight; adopt writes the disable entry and a rerun changes nothing.
